# inflectionts

> English inflection for Effect v4 TypeScript programs: plurals, singulars, a/an, ordinals, number words, check amounts, and count-aware templates, for words not known in advance. A port of Python's inflect. Install with `bun add @ethan-wickstrom/inflectionts effect`; `effect` ^4.1.4 is a peer dependency. Not for fixed count labels (use Intl.PluralRules), projects without Effect (use pluralize), or languages other than English.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/ethan-wickstrom/inflectionts/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, a runnable example with its output, and when not to use it (~830 tokens)
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/ethan-wickstrom/inflectionts/blob/main/skills/inflectionts/SKILL.md): when to choose it, an operation table, defaults, and constraints (~1,040 tokens)

## Tasks

- [How-to guides](https://github.com/ethan-wickstrom/inflectionts/blob/main/docs/how-to.md): label counts with any noun, choose a or an, ordinals and number words, plural names back to singular, amounts on checks, user-written templates, Latin plurals, custom words, typed errors, calling from non-Effect code (~2,330 tokens)
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/ethan-wickstrom/inflectionts/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md): build "There were two hundred and forty-three errors in 12 files" step by step (~760 tokens)

- [Inflector.ts](https://github.com/ethan-wickstrom/inflectionts/blob/main/packages/inflectionts/src/Inflector.ts): the Inflector service, its layers, and every operation, each with a tested example
